_comment: Copy to ~/.config/ae_test/config.json (or point $AE_TEST_CONFIG at it) and fill in the <...> values. Every key is optional: harness.py DEFAULTS has the rest. One config on the laptop (box and windows sections) and one on the build box (data, builds).
data_dir: <folder with maps/ (maps/ce/ for Custom Edition) and mods/<name>/maps>

named_builds.stock: <folder with a stock ChupathingyCE linux64 halo>

windows.ssh: <ssh alias of the Windows test box>
